history.note: Carries the latest Sleuth tracking engine, so updating Chroma never puts an older Sleuth engine back.

Carries the current Sleuth tracking engine (2.22) so Grade and Sleuth stay in step. Restart Resolve after updating.

Grade: the look dropdowns and Intensity sit in a new Look section, and the preset row has a Load button beside the list.

items.name: Utilities | G&G
items.description: The everyday tools: masks, glows, logos, frames, shapes and shadows.
items.notes: Background Layer Engine 1.17: the Tech pieces and Tech look controls now live on the Tech engine itself instead of copies on the hub, which removes about 185 expressions from every frame. Same controls, same looks. Restart Resolve after updating.

history.note: Background Layer Engine 1.17: the Tech pieces and Tech look controls now live on the Tech engine itself instead of copies on the hub, which removes about 185 expressions from every frame. Same controls, same looks. Restart Resolve after updating.

Frames: new Split type Versions. Stack renders of one clip (ungraded, graded, finished) in a Fusion clip; Frames plays version 1, then wipes through each version to the last, with Keep Playing or Freeze Frame (holds the frame during the wipes and resumes after). Wipes Start, Start Wipes Here, Wipe Length, Hold Each, Wipe Ease; Direction, Order, Slant and Divider apply. Restart Resolve after updating.

Shape Layer 2.0: rebuilt on its own GPU engine. Nine shape presets as picture cards (circle to burst), box, polygon and star shapes, Solid / Gradient / Clip Below fill, Stroke, Drop Shadow, Long Shadow, Glow and Inner Shade, Animate In / Out, Morph to any shape and Move, each with its own timing, plus Motion Blur, Shake, Rough Edge, Halftone and Grain. Restart Resolve after updating.

Animate with Start, Mid and End presets on picture cards, Frames 1.14, and Background Layer Engine 1.16 with baked Tech elements and new Cutting Mat looks. New: Element Layer and Elements. Restart Resolve after updating.
New Utilities cover in the inspector header.

New names. Generators end in Layer (Background Layer, Draw On Layer, Mask Layer, Shadow Layer, Shape Layer) and effects are one word (Animate, Clips, Cutout, Frames, Glow, Logo, Mask, Texture). Power Window is retired. The old names are removed on update.
Stabilization works again with this effect on in Resolve 21.2. Restart Resolve after updating.

history.note: New: Subtitle | Cipher. Put it on a subtitle track and every caption gets the Text | Cipher look and motion: same Text, Style and Motion tabs, a Caption Box, Line Length wrapping and Word Sync so words land one by one across each caption.

New Cipher names: Text | Cipher (was Text Lab), L3rds | Cipher (was L3rds Lab), Lists | Cipher (was List Lab Engine (Beta)) and Titles | Cipher (was Title Lab Engine (Beta)); MultiText | Cipher is unchanged. Saved presets keep working. The old names are removed on update.

Text Lab Zoom: new Direction switch (Back | Front) and Zoom Around (Letter | Group | Text | Frame). Group, Text and Frame zoom the text as one piece, so it can push in with a Frame Lab card or a camera move. Existing titles look the same.

Saved presets are safer: saving can no longer overwrite a presets file it could not read, and five rolling backups are kept. Scramble has a Load button next to User Presets for Resolve 21.2. Preset lists ship clean and your own presets are untouched.

items.description: Relight a finished shot: day to night, new skies, flares and motion.
items.notes: Afterlight presets as picture cards, with camera presets and the latest fixes.

history.note: Afterlight presets as picture cards, with camera presets and the latest fixes.
Afterlight gets its own cover in the inspector header (it used to show Chroma's) and a new LIGHT library icon.
Reverted the 1.2 flare and relight tracking change: dragging a lens flare in the viewer could crash Resolve, and every flare control showed a lit keyframe diamond. Back to the 1.1 behaviour.

Lens flares and lights: the crosshair now stays centered on the flare or light through a track (the track is written into Position), and Resolve's own lens flare widget (the point and line) no longer shows on the viewer. Flare preset is a dropdown that applies Resolve's preset. Re-apply Afterlight to pick it up.
Stabilization works again with this effect on in Resolve 21.2. Restart Resolve after updating.
